recency_half_life_days.label: Recency half-life (days)
recency_half_life_days.description: How quickly older listens fade out of the genome. Set to 0 to weigh every listen equally regardless of age.

lastfm_username.label: Last.fm username
lastfm_username.description: Public Last.fm profile to import scrobble history from.

lastfm_api_key.label: Last.fm API key
lastfm_api_key.description: API key used to poll Last.fm's recent-tracks history.

lastfm_poll_enabled.label: Poll Last.fm automatically
lastfm_poll_enabled.description: Periodically import new scrobbles from Last.fm.

lastfm_poll_interval_hours.label: Last.fm poll interval (hours)
lastfm_poll_interval_hours.description: How often to check Last.fm for new scrobbles.

apple_import_dir.label: Apple Music export directory
apple_import_dir.description: Server-side folder containing an already-extracted Apple Music Play Activity export, as an alternative to uploading it from the browser.

enrich_enabled.label: Enrich with MusicBrainz/ListenBrainz
enrich_enabled.description: Look up genres, release years and popularity for artists that appear in your listening history.

obscurity_percentile.label: Obscurity threshold percentile
obscurity_percentile.description: Artists below this ListenBrainz listener-count percentile count toward the obscurity index.

min_seconds_played.label: Minimum seconds played
min_seconds_played.description: A listen must be played for at least this many seconds to count toward the genome.

rebuild_schedule_hour.label: Daily rebuild hour
rebuild_schedule_hour.description: Local hour of day (0-23) at which the genome is recomputed automatically.

clear_genome_data.label: Clear genome data
clear_genome_data.description: Delete all imported listens and cached genome results for this household.

export_db.label: Export genome database
export_db.description: Write a copy of the genome database to the first shared folder this app can reach, so the file editor or Samba can pick it up. Temporary, for moving this data to the standalone integration.

rebuild_now.result: The listening genome has been rebuilt from {0} listens
rebuild_now.result_empty: No listening history yet — nothing to rebuild. Import your Last.fm or Apple Music history from the Listening Genome settings page first.

clear_genome_data.result: All genome data has been cleared

export_db.started: Export started. The result, including where the file was written, appears on the Listening Genome import page.

manifest.name: Listening Genome
manifest.description: Computes a household listening fingerprint from Music Assistant playback, Apple Music exports and Last.fm history.
